caveats: ⚑ CADENCE: the 300-round S2 threshold is kit-exact, but how OFTEN it fires rides the datamined AR cadence + ammo 90 / reloadFrames 81 — proc count per fight is datamine-derived, not measured.
⚑ ESCALATION CAP: assumed to stop at the 3rd own burst cast (kit lists exactly three tiers); 4th+ casts are modeled as re-applying the same 3-step total (87.85%), not a 4th tier.
⚑ SPLIT-VS-MERGE: the 2439.36% distributed hit is modeled as ONE merged hit against the sole partless boss; the real popup split is kit-silent and unread.
crit:true on all three damage lines is the rider-crit prior (riders crit at the caster's sheet rate), NOT a measurement — reversible on popup-colour evidence.
'1 enemy unit(s) with the highest remaining HP' resolves to the sole boss; the ranking clause is untestable in v1 and moves no damage.

The unit's whole offense depends on the self targetMaxHpPct grants feeding atkOfMaxHpPct (legal only because caster===target). If the engine does not re-read live Max HP for that conversion, S1 is silently inert and the unit is under-modeled — verify the feed path before trusting any total.

noFb is unset on every damage line (FB-by-timing default ON). The burst-cast hits are expected FB-exempt by cast timing (burst damage lands before the FB window opens), which is engine timing, not a per-kit flag.
noRange is left to the engine (automatic on riders); hasPierce not set — the kit carries no Pierce line.
override.note: PARSER BASELINE (HYPOTHESIS — NOT a validated model). Every ⚑ below is an UNMEASURED estimate; hand-tune + record against a real fight before trusting any number. 2B (2b), AR/Fire/Defender/Burst III, cd 40s, ammo 90 — an HP→ATK converter with no team-facing effects. S1: burst-cast (own-burst) escalating self Max HP ladder, 10.03% → +20.06% → +57.76%, cumulative per the 'each subsequent effect triggers all effects before it' clause (87.85% total after her 3rd own cast), 'continuously' = no expiry. S2b: passive from battle start, ATK ▲ 6.16% of her OWN final Max HP (atkOfMaxHpPct) — this is the sole channel through which S1 produces damage. S2a: cumulative-300-rounds-fired rider, 167.45% of final ATK to the enemy (hitCount trigger; 'firing N times' counts rounds, not trigger pulls). Burst: two enemy hits resolved on cast — 2439.36% distributed + 792% additional. No weapon swap, no stacks/resources, no pierce, no Hit Rate, no heal/shield/DEF line, no ally-targeted effect; every effect is self- or enemy-scoped, so this unit contributes nothing to a teammate's buffs. All kit lines are implemented — unmodeled is empty by audit, not by omission.

flags.estimate: ~5-7 procs over a 180s fight (one roughly every ~28-33s)
flags.reasoning: Threshold is kit-exact, but proc COUNT is a function of the datamined AR cadence (rate_of_fire is a known-unreliable field and the effective rate is 60/ceil(60/nominal), not nominal) plus ammo 90 and reloadFrames 81. At ~12 effective pulls/s: 90 rounds ≈ 7.5s fire + ~1.35s reload ≈ 8.9s/magazine → ~20 magazines → ~1800 rounds → 6 procs. A ±20% cadence error moves the proc count by a whole proc.
flags.recipe: Count 167.45%-magnitude popups in a recorded 2b fight and compare to the sim's proc count; independently pin the cadence by reading the ammo counter (rounds/sec) rather than any downstream FB-count measure.

flags.estimate: Caps at the 3rd own burst cast; total 87.85% Max HP thereafter
flags.reasoning: The kit enumerates exactly three tiers and gives no wrap/reset clause. With cd 40s she can cast 3-4 times in 180s, so the 4th cast is inside the observable window and the assumption is load-bearing for late-fight ATK.
flags.recipe: Record a fight where 2b casts her burst 4+ times; read the HP bar (or her normal-attack popup magnitudes, which scale via atkOfMaxHpPct) across casts 3 and 4 — a flat step means the cap holds.

flags.reasoning: 'Distributed damage' is a split across enemies; with a single partless boss the sim total is identical either way, but the popup shape (and any per-hit crit roll) differs — kit-silent, and crit resolution on N split hits is not the same variance as on 1.
flags.recipe: Read the burst-cast popups frame-by-frame: one large number vs N smaller ones summing to the same total.
